title: Tutor Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for tutoring services — sessions, packages, lesson prep, travel, materials and online lessons. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 7 — payment due within 7 days. Package sessions are valid for 3 months from purchase.
notes: Thank you for your business. Cancellations accepted with 24 hours' notice; otherwise the session is billed.
features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled tutoring line items: sessions, packages, prep, travel, materials, online
Package expiry terms printed on the invoice avoid credit disputes
Student and guardian fields keep billing and attendance clear

faqs.q: What should I include on a tutor invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name, the student and billing contact, a dated line-item list (sessions, packages, prep, materials), tax, and a total due. Print your cancellation and package expiry policy so families know the terms.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your tax authority and a CPA or attorney before use.
